goal: Find one broad, genuinely novel world-model security mechanism with target idea novelty 7-7.5 and an ICLR-scale experimental path, after falsifying temporal-order planner-only causality.
available_carriers: official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M with native horizon-3 MPC and native online adaptation
MBRL-Lib PETS/ensemble probabilistic model with native planner
WorldAgen/LIBERO checkpoint with native-style causal dynamics adaptation screen
threat_model: attacker executes only authentic legal environment actions and submits real observations/rewards; no observation, reward, parameter, label, or task-id edits; shared world model is updated from those transitions; attacker exits before victim evaluation
strongest_current_evidence: cheetah-run ordered cascade can lower held-out walker-run MPC return with low one-step error under dynamics-only update, while reverse/shuffle recover; source-target selectivity exists, but actor-restore after full update leaves cascade -4.6%/+8.2% across seeds, so planner-only causality is weak and Round19 rejected it
design_hint: Survey literature flags state/provenance integrity, cross-layer propagation, compositional defenses and long-horizon closed-loop evaluation as underexplored. Consider a mechanism where truthful source-valid evidence is transformed by the shared model into target-task counterfactual evidence through provenance/context loss, but do not merely rename negative transfer. The mechanism must have a native, explicit mediator and a short (<120 s) falsification gate.

required_output.prior_art_boundary: why distinct from SWAAP/TRAP/OEP/WorldM Lie/standard negative transfer
